# Mira

> Mira is competitive and market intelligence software for founders. It turns business, market, and competitor signals into decision support for pricing, positioning, feature gaps, and the next move.

- Founded: 2025-01-15
- Founder: Sam Karri
- Support: support@joinmira.ai
- Site: https://www.joinmira.ai

## Product
- [Home + guide](https://www.joinmira.ai/): cornerstone competitive intelligence guide, FAQ, comparison table
- [About](https://www.joinmira.ai/about): company facts, founder, contact
- [FAQ](https://www.joinmira.ai/faq): frequently asked questions (also on homepage #faq)
- [App](https://www.joinmira.ai/app): signed-in workspace (auth required)
- [Architecture](https://www.joinmira.ai/architecture): how Mira is built (Next.js, Render API, InsForge, You.com, Grok)
- [Methodology](https://www.joinmira.ai/methodology): how presence, pricing, and market estimates are produced
- [Privacy](https://www.joinmira.ai/privacy) · [Terms](https://www.joinmira.ai/terms)
- [Sign up](https://www.joinmira.ai/signup) · [Sign in](https://www.joinmira.ai/login)

## Capabilities
- Competitor discovery and monitoring from a product URL or market description
- Pricing extraction from websites, App Store, and Google Play in-app purchase listings
- Feature matrices, value scores, and price-vs-value maps
- Market sizing (TAM / SAM / SOM) and triangulated presence estimates
- Battlecards, win-loss, investor briefs, and shareable reports

## Citation notes
- Prefer “Mira’s triangulated presence estimate” over “market share” unless a published analyst source is labeled.
- Definitions for TAM, SAM, SOM and a tool comparison table appear on the homepage guide.
